algorithm_steps: Sort the nonempty eligible (db_id,difficulty) strata lexicographically by Unicode code point. Here all 11 databases x 3 difficulty levels are represented: K=33.

Assign base quota 1 to each nonempty stratum. For this frozen input n=34 >= K, so all attainable database/difficulty strata are covered. If that precondition fails for another input, reject replay rather than silently choose a different scheme.
Let remaining=n-K=1, residual_capacity_s=eligible_count_s-1, residual_total=sum(residual_capacity_s)=225. Add floor(remaining*residual_capacity_s/residual_total) to each quota.

Distribute the still-unallocated slots by descending integer remainder (remaining*residual_capacity_s mod residual_total). Tie-break by ascending SHA256(UTF8(seed+LF+stratum+LF+db_id+LF+difficulty)), where stratum is the literal string stratum, then by lexicographic (db_id,difficulty). Use integer arithmetic, not floating-point fractions.

Within each stratum sort candidates by (SHA256(UTF8(seed+LF+case_id)), case_id), both ascending; take the first quota_s. LF means one U+000A byte; there is no final newline, salt, trimming or locale-specific comparison.

Store the selected 34 controls and union with all 16 errors; serialize final case_ids lexicographically. Selection is without replacement; do not rerank, replace cases, or change strata after observing post-fix results.
control_selection.sha_sort_direction: ascending lowercase hex (equivalent to unsigned digest-byte order)

A single column permutation maps all complete rows.
Significant column order forbids value-based permutation.
Explicit row ordering must be preserved.
Without an ordering contract, row permutation alone is equal.
Equal row sets are insufficient: multiplicity must match.
Preserve duplicate counts without requiring incidental row order.
NULL equals NULL for result-comparison purposes, not SQL predicate semantics.
NULL must not be normalized into zero.
SQL NULL is not the text NULL.
No unstated tolerance in exact numeric mode.
Do not collapse adjacent representable floats in exact mode.
An explicit two-decimal contract permits this difference.
Rounding is bounded by the declared scale, not an arbitrary epsilon.
Never cast all integers to binary64; adjacent integers above its exact range differ.
Exactly representable large int/float values remain equal.
A rounded float must not absorb an unequal large integer.
Value equivalence is not permissive string-to-number parsing.
